{"metadata":{"description":"DSH 社区 Windows 桌面插件：窗口截图、界面控件、鼠标键盘、会话授权与操作审计。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。","id":"gh:1423648395","install_available":true,"language":"C#","name":"deepseek-computer-use","slug":"STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use","topics":["accessibility","computer-use","deepseek-harness","desktop-automation","dsh","dsh-plugin","uia","windows"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH 社区 Windows 桌面插件：窗口截图、界面控件、鼠标键盘、会话授权与操作审计。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**简体中文** · English"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# Computer Use"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**让 DSH 在授权范围内操作 Windows 应用。**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseek-computer-use) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseek-co"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"www.npmjs.com/package/deepseek-computer-use) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseek-computer-use)"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**安装使用 · 使用流程 · 完整说明**"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 功能"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- 先查看窗口截图或界面控件，再决定下一步。

- 检查实际结果，保留操作审计与中断能力。"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## 安装"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"在 DSH 桌面版「插件」面板安装 `deepseek-computer-use`。已配置命令行时也可使用："},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"网页版把 `desktop` 改为 `web`；安装后重启对应的 DSH。宿主要求以包声明 `>=0.2.1-rc.3` 为准。"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## 开始使用"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"1. 在 Windows 10/11 的实际 DSH profile 中安装 deepseek-computer-use，然后创建新会话。
2. 打开目标软件，并在对话中说明要操作的应用、目标和允许范"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"围。

5. 检查软件中的实际结果；需要中断时"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"让助手查看窗口截图或界面控件，再执行点击和输入。
